headline: MMC Introduces a New AI Methodology for Understanding Culture
summary: MMC, an Omnicom Public Relations agency, today introduced a new methodology for understanding culture, designed to identify emerging shifts before they become conventional wisdom and translate them into strategic communications insight. The methodology is brought to life through WEATHERVaiNE, MMC's proprietary cultural insights engine, powered by Bluefish AI, an agentic marketing platform.
